common_controller_bus.missing_current_source: Monolithic per-lane mapper physical master places all4 boundaries together; it provides no source-bound registered grid broadcast geometry.

placement_constraints.each_edge: Actual ETM literal Q/P pins, phi−R clock entry, H100 and setup/hold per bit. ≤500um alone is not qualification; root/bit-specific reach can be~300–400um.
placement_constraints.path_budget: Controller-source Q→stage0D→stage1D→stage2D→stage3D→selected body pin. Exactly4 mapper captures plus existing bodyb_q1. Stage arithmetic cannot move across those edges without oracle proof.
placement_constraints.example_only: For an8x2 body pack, central point to far corner can exceed1200um Manhattan. Three post-S0 hops need~400um each even before literal pins. A right-column source can need>1700um. A shared central S0 does not prove all paths close.
placement_constraints.required: Distributed source/controller output capture, branch copies or larger geometry must bind actual existing stages and exact clocks; no declared-spine waiver or artificial multicycle.
placement_constraints.clock_roots: All physical stage masters require own actual sink-count/CTS/pin/cut inventories; source-sharing is not a root or slot grant.
